title: Someone will look
caption: A sale was missing from Neha's book, and she wanted someone to look. Lumi tells her story.
linkedin_text: In ScoreMyBiz the owner can write what went wrong, get a ticket number and see the reply inside the app. The app states a target of replying within 24 hours; it is a target, not a guarantee.

cast.neha: Neha, a young Indian woman who runs a small stationery shop, with a short bob haircut, in a mustard kurta and round glasses

scenes.clip: Lumi, a young Indian woman with long dark hair in a navy blazer and white top, facing the camera in a small stationery shop with shelves of notebooks and pens behind her, a warm smile.
scenes.vo: Hi, I'm Lumi. This is Neha's story. One morning a sale she wrote was missing from her book.
